correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive reconstruction formed the 28 Fano-nonline triples and their 42 disjointness edges; enumerated all 196,009 independent sets including empty and matched exact 98,000 distinct nonempty Hasse pairs. A separately implemented complete 1,319,724-incidence DAG topological sort visited all 196,008 nonempty faces. The only critical faces are one dimension-0 and seven dimension-6 simplices. Forman discrete Morse gives one 0-cell and seven 6-cells; every 6-cell attaches to a point, proving the integral homotopy wedge of 7 S^6. Exact finite verification is exhaustive over this named graph; no general graph family is inferred.
